messages:
mira-ux: Dropping new invite drawer comps for review. Main goals: make SSO enforcement obvious, prevent accidental admin grants, and make CSV previews accessible. Please skim and drop quick reactions.

kevin-eng: Quick read. Backend note: we need invite payloads to include role_id, sso_override (nullable), expires_at. If org requires SSO we should return a 400 for invites attempting to bypass unless a super-admin override is provided.

anya-ops: Ops ask: show who created the invite link and when it expires in the drawer summary. Also have a rotate link action in-line. For CSV uploads, preview must allow removing rows before sending.

olivia-security: Security: absolutely require an explicit checkbox when an invite grants any admin-level perms. Wording: "I understand this will grant admin privileges to these accounts." Also require audit events recording actor, prior_state, new_role, and sso_enforced boolean.

mira-ux: UX question: should the SSO indicator live at the drawer header (global) and a column in the CSV preview, or only inline per-row? My leaning: header indicates org policy, per-row badges show effective status.

tulio-pm: Product preference: show org-level SSO policy at top (read-only if enforced) plus an "Override per invite" column only if org policy allows. Keeps confusion down.

kevin-eng: Implementation: we can compute effective_sso server-side and return it in the CSV preview payload so UI shows consistent badges. Sample response we plan: { "row": 2, "email": "a@x.com", "effective_sso": "enforced" }.

mira-ux: Copy suggestions: invite email subject: "You're invited to join <Org Name> on Redwood Inference"; first line: "Sign in with your organization's SSO or use this invite link." Avoid the word "corporate" per Olivia's earlier feedback.

olivia-security: Slight tweak: "Use your organization's SSO provider to sign in. If your org requires SSO this invite will enforce it." Also log domain info but redact local-parts in audit logs where PII rules apply.

anya-ops: Accessibility: CSV preview table must support keyboard nav. When a row is focused Enter opens inline editor; Escape cancels edits. Screen reader should announce validation errors. Also drag-drop to reorder invites for reviewers who like that.

mira-ux: Validation states in the comps: invalid email, domain mismatch, already-member, duplicate. I added inline suggestions: "Use existing user" with a CTA to open a reassignment modal.

kevin-eng: We'll surface server validation codes: domain_mismatch, existing_member, invalid_format. UI will map those to friendly strings. For large CSVs, we'll stream validation results back so the UI updates progressively.

mira-ux: For SSO badges in compact rows I used 2-letter badges: "EN" (enforced), "OP" (optional), with aria-labels like "SSO: enforced at organization level". Not color-dependent.

olivia-security: For audit deep-links: when someone clicks "View in audit" from an invite or role, prefill filters: event_type=invite_created OR event_type=role_assignment, invite_id or role_id, and a time window (30d). Also include a copyable permalink.

kevin-eng: We'll add support for audit query params: e.g., /audit?event=invite_created&invite_id=abc123&from=2025-01-01. Backend will sanity-check and enforce rate-limits for heavy queries.

mira-ux: Admin confirmation microflow: when sending invites that include admin roles, show modal listing affected emails and a checkbox confirming intent. Modal copy: "You're about to grant admin access to X users. This will allow them to manage org settings. Confirm to proceed."

anya-ops: Add a "Save as draft" action for large batches so PMs can hand off invites for review. Drafts should be stored with uploader id and file hash.

olivia-security: Also require an approval flow flag for organizations that enable two-step approvals. If approval_flow_id present, sending should create a pending audit event instead of immediate role assignment.

kevin-eng: Telemetry we plan: invite_bulk_upload, invite_preview_validation_failures, invite_send_batch_count, invite_override_used. We'll also emit compact_mode_toggle for opt-in testing of the compact UI.

mira-ux: Accessibility extras: respect prefers-reduced-motion, dialogs trap focus and return focus on close, table sorting announces order, and ensure color contrast for badges. I added a keyboard appendix in the Figma file.

tulio-pm: Acceptance criteria draft: 1) Drawer UI shows org SSO policy and per-row effective SSO badges; 2) CSV preview with server-side validation + keyboard nav; 3) Admin-role confirmation modal + audit events logged; 4) Deep-link to audit with filters; 5) Draft/save and rotate link actions implemented.

invite-bot: Reminder scheduled: please review final copy on Thu 9am PT.

mira-ux: I'll update Figma with these changes and post a final pass tomorrow. Thanks all! :sparkles:
